programRef: world-engine-history-program-2026-06-27/ROADMAP-v2-condition-first.md §3.1 V2-2 row (SIGNED OFF 2026-07-03) + §5.1 Option-A router / §5.3 AC table (the V2-2a subset) / §5.5 non-goals + §7a RESOLVED split ('router + both anchors first, stagnant response + mixed interior second'); pre-code gate briefs (all three RESOLVED 2026-07-03): gate-1-L-lidstrength-form-DESIGN.md (L_STRONG≈0.63 §4 + router-boundary table), gate-2-localyield-DESIGN.md (tidal-shoulder PG-5 SHOULDER_LO≈0.15, m_hp-before-L, the effectiveL hand-up), gate-3-interpenetration-statistic-DESIGN.md (primitiveId enum + familyOf plumbing, Open-Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4). GROUNDING.md (same dir). This is the FIRST half of the V2-2 split; the SECOND half is world-engine-v2-2b (mixed interior + stagnant response).
designDecisions: primitiveId a/b seam (grounding Q1 / gate-3 Open-Q1,Q2): V2-2a AUTHORS the primitiveId enum + familyOf map (+ optional uniform per-node corner emit); V2-2b POPULATES multi-valued + co-emits centerId + measures Π=C·F. Lava-plain and stagnant-basaltic-plain are DISTINCT ids (gate-3 Open-Q2) — do not lump. See AC-PRIMITIVEID-SCHEMA.

tune-builder naming (grounding Q2): the router REUSES the existing magmaDriversToTune (magmatism.js:113) for the weak side. NO new lidDriversToTune alias in V2-2a. The §5.3 AC-table name 'lidDriversToTune' is satisfied by magmaDriversToTune. See AC-TUNE-NULL.

live probe (grounding Q3): headless-only. V2-2a renders nothing new, so the _lab.lidRouteProbe() live shadow surface is DEFERRED (optional, not built). No live/integration browser AC; verification is entirely headless (the V2-0 pattern). If a build wants a console-clean AC7-style probe it is additive and NOT a UAT.

mixed-detection test world (grounding Q4): AC-CONFORMANCE-FINE asserts BOTH — (a) all 15 mapped presets classify non-mixed, AND (b) a hand-set mid-axis vector classifies mixed. Locking the mixed seam now (b) is what makes the V2-2b drop-in a clean swap. See AC-CONFORMANCE-FINE + AC-MIXED-STUB.

mixed stub (grounding Q5): return-marker, NOT a hard throw. writeLidResponseSphere on fineClass 'mixed' returns { path:'lid-mixed', fineClass:'mixed', unimplemented:true } and LEAVES carrier.height UNWRITTEN (honors §5.5 'no new height-writing machinery'; no golden movable; ergonomic for tests). See AC-MIXED-STUB.

T_ss delivery (grounding Q6 / D3-MF3): the router RECEIVES precomputed T_ss in opts (caller computes locked ? (T_eq ?? 0) * 1.4 : 0, matching planet-lod-rivers.js:476 exactly), so the pure-weak branch is a verbatim pass-through and byte-identity is STRUCTURAL, not re-derived. The router does NOT recompute T_ss internally. See AC-TSS-PRE-GATE.

AC2/AC3 disposition (must-fix #2; §5.3 row / grounding Q4): at the two anchors, AC2/AC3 (structure + latitude-control) are SUBSUMED by AC-BYTE-* — the router's corner output is byte-identical to the shipped Lava/Magma/Venus worlds that ALREADY PASS AC2/AC3, so bit-for-bit equality proves them without a standalone re-run. The mixed-world AC2/AC3 (a NEW rendered surface) is V2-2b. V2-2a therefore carries no standalone AC2/AC3 row.

Strong-branch regime is ARCHETYPE-FREE (must-fix #3): the router resolves the pure-strong regime by mapping the E1 coordinate geodynamicRegime==='stagnant' → the single V2-2a strong constant 'venus-stagnant-lid'. It NEVER calls stagnantLidRegimeOf(archetype) — stagnantLid.js:78 takes a preset LABEL as its first arg, which violates the signed 'router consumes E1 coordinates, never labels' invariant and AC-0's grep denylist. stagnantLidRegimeOf(archetype,locked) is imported ONLY by the TEST to compute the expected regime value. See AC-BYTE-STRONG-REF + AC-0.

Classification-constant source of truth (must-fix #4): L_STRONG(0.63, e1Regime.js:43) and SHOULDER_LO(0.15, :44) are module-private `const` today; HEATPIPE_PEG(0.45, :40) is already `export const`. V2-2a makes ONE byte-safe export-only edit — adds the `export` keyword to L_STRONG and SHOULDER_LO (changes no runtime value, moves no golden) — so the router IMPORTS all three from e1Regime.js, the single source of truth. The router MUST NOT re-declare 0.63/0.15 (AC-0 grep asserts import-not-redeclare), so a UAT retune of these UAT-tunable constants can never make the router's classifyLidPath diverge from computeE1's own geodynamicRegime routing at the V2-3 dispatch flip. See mustStayWorking (permitted export-only edit) + AC-0.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Spine conformance (Rule 15 / SPINE-CONFORMANCE.md), the standing world-engine AC-0. (1) Driver connectivity: classifyLidPath/isUnbrokenLidPath read ONLY E1 coordinates (compositionClass, geodynamicRegime, L, m_hp, and the raw Io-ratio via cv.rawTidalIoRatio) + the precomputed T_ss named derivation locked?(T_eq??0)*1.4:0 — every one D-slot-backed or a named derivation per the V2-1 AC-0 tables; NO archetype-string input to the router, grep-audited with an explicit DENYLIST: router source contains no e1.label read, no PRESET_ARCHETYPE read, AND no call to stagnantLidRegimeOf( (nor any archetype-string argument anywhere) — a router that calls stagnantLidRegimeOf(archetype) to obtain the strong-branch regime FAILS AC-0; it MUST instead map the E1 coordinate geodynamicRegime==='stagnant' → the single strong constant 'venus-stagnant-lid' (must-fix #3). Source-of-truth check (must-fix #4): the router IMPORTS its classification constants L_STRONG/SHOULDER_LO (and HEATPIPE_PEG) from e1Regime.js — grep asserts it does NOT re-declare the literals 0.63/0.15 (single source of truth; no second constant that could diverge from computeE1's geodynamicRegime at the V2-3 flip). Accepted debt to declare: dispatch (writeBodyRelief) still routes on PRESET_ARCHETYPE — that is the un-wired seam, retired at V2-3; the router itself is archetype-free. (2) Named consumer: every field the router emits has a named reader from the ROADMAP-v2 DAG — fineClass → AC-CONFORMANCE-FINE now + V2-3 dispatch; primitiveId enum + familyOf → V2-2b interpenetration statistic (gate-3); corner-diag pass-through → existing magmaProbe/stagnantLidProbe. No dead fields. (3) Taxonomy registration: if any lab control is added it registers in planet-archetypes.js; the deferred route probe is console/_lab-only (no *Enabled key) ⇒ drift guards stay green with no taxonomy change.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: T_ss computed BEFORE the classification gate and passed through UNCHANGED (D3-MF3, grounding Q6). The caller computes T_ss = locked ?
